_comment: Reduced build. This is the default. It is a launcher: open the apps, open the calendar, change the brightness, and say a command out loud. Swap values here and rebuild. Settings stays on because a launcher you cannot configure is a launcher you cannot keep using, and the digest page stays on because a calendar with nowhere to live is not a feature. voiceCommand is on because the commands it runs — the clock, the volume, the brightness, the music, a timer — never leave the device, and the microphone is asked for at the moment the microphone button is pressed.
